limitations: Selected Results/Discussion and Figure captions inspected as rendered primary manuscript text hosted by ResearchGate with matching DOI/date banner. Raw mirror request returned HTTP 403; original publisher full text, methods, figures, supplements, cohort rosters and source-specific reuse remain unqualified. Rendered manuscript text has no observed source-byte hash; the intake receipt pins this curated dataset and generated outputs only.

Figure 1D and Figure 2D denominator labels are timepoint/platform assessment counts; they are not all-start denominators and cannot be summed across culture days.

The plots show experiment-level percentages as mean ± SEM; exact normally developed embryo numerators per plotted denominator are not supplied by these labels, so no pooled success ratio is reconstructed.
DASGIP has no bar shown at E7.5-start day +5.5 and no bar shown at E6.5-start day +6; each absence is retained as unreported, not as zero or proof of no assessment.

Extended Data Figure 3D contributes 36 strain/serum/timepoint emb labels and printed n labels; its caption does not define the unit for n or separately state the denominator frame. These labels are retained without pooled outcome-rate reconstruction.

Extended Data Figure 3G contributes six CD1 × CD1 independent-laboratory OxyStreamer timepoint labels; the caption defines emb as embryos evaluated and n as independent experiments. No normal-embryo numerators or cross-day identities are supplied.
Extended Data Figure 3D serum statements are not merged with the distinct Extended Data Figure 4D serum comparison; group and stage context require separate qualification.

The Cycle 274 screen of the official bioRxiv full-text/data/supplement routes and bounded NCBI GEO, BioProject and DataCite queries located no separate Figure 4D source table, embryo denominator table or matching repository record; this does not establish global absence or exhaust unsearched repositories.

Cycle 275 version-status screen: the official bioRxiv DOI API returned v1 only; Crossref classifies the DOI as posted-content; the matching ORCID record labels it a preprint; exact-title PubMed and bounded Europe PMC DOI/title-author searches returned no match. No journal-version match surfaced in these checks; this does not rule out a retitled or incompletely indexed report.

Cycle 276 extended the bounded repository screen to EMBL-EBI BioStudies and MetaboLights public search APIs. Exact DOI/title queries returned zero; BioStudies author AND embryo returned two older, different studies, retained in a disambiguation crosswalk. No target-linked accession or source-data file was located in these query results. This is not a repository-wide absence claim; other indexes, unlinked identifiers, private records, and unindexed/retitled deposits remain possible.

Cycle 277 checked official Zenodo, Figshare, GitHub repository search and OpenAIRE APIs. OpenAIRE returned one exact-DOI publication record pointing to an EPFL Infoscience full-text bitstream, but no exact-DOI dataset record; EPFL record and bitstream requests returned HTTP 429, so that copy could not be verified or inspected for additional attachments. GitHub title/author repository searches returned zero. Figshare DOI/author searches returned zero and a broad title search returned five unrelated 2021 supplement records. Zenodo title/author searches returned zero, while its exact-DOI request returned HTTP 500, not a valid zero. No target-linked source-data accession was verified. These are bounded indexes and routes, not a global absence result.

Cycle 278 queried the official Metabolomics Workbench REST API using its documented study_title and last_name search fields. Full/core target-title, ex-utero, gastrulation and metabolic-program title queries returned zero; Lokshtanov, Aguilera, Solmonson and Maza last-name queries returned zero. The broad “mouse embryo” title query returned seven different studies; their metadata is retained in a disambiguation crosswalk. The API specification exposes no DOI input for study searches, so an exact-DOI query was not available here. No target-linked metabolomics accession or file was found in these bounded metadata routes; this does not establish global absence.
